purpose: Read-only operational dashboard for database size, table statistics, schema migration status and connection-pool utilization.
primaryGoal: Inspect database storage and runtime health, identify large tables, review migration state and independently refresh the three diagnostic sources.

dataSources.behavior: Forwards AbortSignal; retains inherited query policy. Backend returns public table schema/name/row_count, table_count and numeric database_size bytes. Does not currently return size_bytes, index_count or last_vacuum.
Forwards AbortSignal. Actual backend payload is version and dirty only; page preserves version/currentVersion compatibility and treats missing pending/history as unknown/empty.

Forwards AbortSignal. Payload supplies max_open/open/in_use/idle/wait_count plus other runtime diagnostics, but no wait_duration_ms. Client exposes snake_case and camelCase keys without manufacturing missing fields.

components.name: PageLayout
components.usage: Title, subtitle, metadata, refresh action, three query sources; no competing shell or workspace controls.

components.name: DBHealthSummary
components.usage: Three independent OperationalBrief source banks; six metrics; useOperationalMetrics, Badge, Text and source timestamps.

components.name: GlassPanel / PanelTitle / Caption / Label / Text / Button
components.usage: Existing surfaces, typography, refresh and three pressed sort controls.

components.name: DataTable
components.usage: Stable tableId, five column renderers, value filters, pagination, persistent layout and existing loaded-row export pipeline.

components.name: ChartContainer and chart barrel
components.usage: Horizontal top-15 row-count series, tooltip, accessible data columns and inherited chart interactions.

components.name: MetricBar
components.usage: Null-safe, named pool progressbar; solid fill; reduced-motion-aware animation.

components.name: TimeStamp / FadeIn / Skeleton / EmptyState / QueryError / StaleRefreshWarning / VisuallyHidden
components.usage: Existing date presentation, entry motion, independent source states, recovery and semantic section headings.

components.name: useDataState / useNumberFormatting
components.usage: Existing retained-payload trust and user precision/locale subscriptions.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page-local binary byte formatter overlaps databaseSizeDisplay in DBHealthSummary.tsx:11 and existing numberFormat.ts:163/useNumberFormatting.ts:40. The local formatter also lacks the shared finite-value guard.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing preference-aware formatBytes bridge for table cells and the existing shared metric bytes formatting contract; preserve binary scaling, B/KB/MB/GB labels, rounding, locale and zero-versus-missing behavior.

responsive.sourceBehavior: Both detail grids stack below xl and use a 2:1 split at xl. Table toolbar wraps; chart has fixed 340px height and 140px category axis; migration history and table have bounded scroll regions.

findings.rule: MDC-023/MDC-043: mobile must preserve all details
findings.detail: mobileColumns contains only name/size/rows. DataTable.tsx:725 applies hidden md:table-cell to index and vacuum columns. Page supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable row details; these values cannot be inspected in the narrow table even if enabled in the column menu.
findings.fix: Opt into the existing mobilePresentation full-detail adapter or an existing accessible detail expansion, preserving index/vacuum information, all filters, ordering, pagination, saved tableId and export scope.

findings.rule: MDC-043: narrow chart and long labels
findings.detail: A fixed 140px Y axis competes with plot width at 320px; names are truncated before reaching both plot and accessible data (line 115), so long table identities are lost from the chart's data alternative. Clipping/overflow itself is unverified.
findings.fix: Retain full names in source-backed chart data/table/export and apply truncation only to visible axis ticks; exercise existing chart sizing at required widths before changing geometry.

accessibility.sourceStrengths: Refresh has localized aria-label; sort controls expose aria-pressed and a named group; decorative icons are hidden; chart has ariaLabel and data columns; sections use hidden h2 labels; MetricBar names missing readings without aria-valuenow.

findings.detail: No caption or name is supplied. DataTable.tsx:929 therefore uses persistence key system:db-health-tables as its native caption rather than the localized visible Tables title.
findings.fix: Pass a localized caption/name without changing tableId or existing persistence keys.

findings.detail: Sort buttons and the refresh button at line 232 use size sm; Button.tsx:40 gives 36px height, below the contract's preferred 44px mobile target. Actual spacing exceptions, focus, long translations and hit areas were not exercised.
findings.fix: Use existing Button sizing or responsive target classes and wrapping support where needed; validate keyboard, translated labels and touch spacing instead of introducing another control primitive.

states.initialLoading: Summary suppresses measurements per source; chart/table/migration/pool have independent loading surfaces.
states.empty: Chart and table handle no tables; migration history/source and pool have EmptyState fallbacks. Unsupported backend fields remain dashes rather than invented values.
states.fatalError: useDataState.fatalError controls replacement per source; QueryError offers source-specific retry; summary exposes source error text.
states.retainedRefreshError: Retained payload remains visible; StaleRefreshWarning appears for chart, migration and pool and source briefs show trust state.
states.offline: Existing useDataState delegates paused refresh to stale retained-data semantics; no live browser/offline exercise was performed.
states.unknown: Pool usage requires finite numerator and positive denominator; totals and large-table counts require complete fields. Missing migration dirty state is not clean.

findings.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045: unknown is not measured zero
findings.detail: Failed COUNT queries log and leave int64 RowCount at zero; failed pg_database_size at lines 60-62 similarly leaves dbSize zero. Successful HTTP payload then appears measured/complete to the page and its six summary metrics; frontend cannot distinguish genuine zero from failed measurement.
findings.fix: Integration owner must expose nullable failed measurements and partial-source evidence through the existing typed API/trust contract. Preserve genuine zero and retained independent sources; do not infer failures heuristically or change backend in this audit.

findings.detail: Header says Auto-refresh 30s while migrations poll every 60s (useAdmin.ts:326); spinner reflects only statsFetching. Independent brief timestamps correctly preserve distinct source observations, but header implies a uniform refresh cadence.
findings.fix: Keep existing polling intervals/query keys; make header wording and aggregate refresh indication accurately reflect the three independently refreshing sources.

visualIssues.detail: Pool fill explicitly selects neon-red/neon-cyan; decorative headings use fixed cyan-300 at lines 326/429/479 and migration divider uses border-white at line 376. Status/body text also uses fixed pastel colors rather than semantic theme roles. Actual brightness and contrast are not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic success/warning/danger and neutral border/text tokens; keep pool 80% threshold, numeric readout, names and user chart palette preferences. Do not reset saved theme IDs or invent a palette.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-034/MDC-040: chart meaning must match data
visualIssues.detail: Visible title and ariaLabel describe table sizes, while chartData sorts top fifteen by rowCount (lines 109-118), Bar uses rows (line 312), and accessible data column is Rows. Source does not provide per-table byte sizes.
visualIssues.fix: Truthfully label the existing row-count chart, with canonical localization owner support if needed; preserve the series/top-15 ranking. A byte-size chart requires an explicitly integrated backend measurement, never a guessed conversion.

architectureIssues.detail: Table2 is rendered but absent from the lucide-react import at lines 3-6 and has no local declaration. Database is imported but unused. This is source evidence of an unresolved icon identifier; no compiler was run and no fix was applied.
architectureIssues.fix: Assigned implementation owner should resolve the icon through the established icon policy; retain Tables heading, action/state behavior and source ownership.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045/MDC-046: typed contracts must describe real payloads
architectureIssues.detail: TableInfo requires sizeBytes/indexCount/lastVacuum absent from backend; DBStats.databaseSize is string but backend returns numeric bytes; MigrationStatus requires currentVersion/pending/migrations but backend emits version/dirty; ConnectionPool requires waitDurationMs absent from RuntimeInfo. Page currently tolerates several omissions, but rich mock fixtures do not prove real endpoint capability.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should reconcile DTOs and optionality against actual JSON/camelCaseKeys, keeping bytes on wire/cache. Preserve all existing table, history, pending and wait-duration UI as unavailable when unsupported rather than deleting sections or inventing data.

architectureIssues.detail: Size sorting falls back to rowCount when sizeBytes is absent, silently comparing row counts with bytes for mixed payloads; with current backend it is actually row sorting under a Size button.
architectureIssues.fix: Sort known byte sizes as bytes and keep missing-size rows explicitly unknown, with stable documented ordering. Preserve the size/rows/name actions and their independent chart sort rather than fabricating size measurements.

architectureIssues.detail: System summary imports generic sourceBriefStatus from another feature's statstrip-api-quality directory. The helper contains generic trust-state presentation rather than system business logic.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared owner should review promotion of the existing helper into the established shared data-display/trust owner without duplicating it or changing status translation keys.

order: Report unresolved Table2 identifier for assigned implementation owner
Correct misleading chart/sort meaning and typed API capabilities
Adopt restrained theme-aware presentation and localized accessible naming

requiredSharedChanges.name: Honest typed database diagnostic source contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Optional unsupported table sizes/indexes/vacuum, migration pending/history and wait duration; actual version/dirty and numeric database_size; nullable failed measurements and partial trust metadata.
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Report only; no backend or shared write authorized.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse existing formatter and mobile table capabilities
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation full-detail adapter or expandable/renderExpanded; localized caption; preserve tableId, columns, filters, pagination and loaded-result exports. Existing useNumberFormatting.formatBytes supplies locale/precision/null behavior.
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Existing owners are sufficient by source inspection; no speculative new shared component requested.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Review canonical source-status presentation ownership
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: DataState status/isRefreshing plus loading and translator -> existing localized statusLabel and OperationalTone; retain refreshing/loading/initialFailure/stale/partial/unavailable semantics.
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Only this assigned consumer and the imported owner were inspected; no claim of whole-app consumer inventory.

competingImplementations.recommendation: Reuse canonical formatting rather than add another formatter.

competingImplementations.pattern: Layout, tables, charts and source trust
competingImplementations.recommendation: Keep existing owners; no competing engine or new library needed.

sections.name: Top-15 table row-count chart (currently titled table sizes)
Tables, value filters and size/rows/name sorting

actions: Inherited ChartContainer data alternative and controls
dataBehavior: Three independent cancellable queries and existing query keys; 30s statistics/pool and 60s migration polling.
Retained data on refresh failures; fatal replacement only for the failed source; source-specific last-success timestamps.
Top-15 chart independently sorts by row count regardless of table sort.
Pool utilization is clamped 0-100 and requires finite values and positive maximum; >=80% condition preserved.
Large-table threshold remains 100*1024*1024 bytes; unknown sizes do not become large-table count zero.
All five table columns, schema/raw table identity, full names, migration dirty/version/pending and latest five migration entries, and six pool fields must survive.
Bytes remain raw bytes; milliseconds field is unsupported by inspected backend and must not be guessed or converted on wire/cache.
Locale/precision preferences, timestamp presentation, tableId system:db-health-tables, current workspace and theme persistence remain unchanged.

Route is an instantaneous global diagnostic: absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and present in VEHICLE_DISABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:117). Do not introduce date/vehicle filters or competing selectors.

evidenceLimits.method: Read-only source inspection of the assigned mounted page and concrete page-specific presentation/data owners. No source/shared/queue/Git mutations.
evidenceLimits.protocol: Assigned JSON report did not exist at start; schema and release protocol were read from docs\frontend-worker-conventions.md.
evidenceLimits.tests: NOT RUN. Existing DBHealthPage test source was inspected only; mocks and authored assertions are not execution evidence.
evidenceLimits.typeScript: NOT RUN. Unresolved icon is recorded as a source/compiler-risk finding only.
evidenceLimits.fullAuditScript: NOT RUN: inspected audit.sh invokes project-wide npx tsc --noEmit and was not used during this bounded source-only audit.
evidenceLimits.lintBuild: NOT RUN; prohibited full gates and no validation baton.
evidenceLimits.routeVerification: Source match confirmed for all three request paths in router.go; reachability/authentication/response behavior was not exercised.
evidenceLimits.sourceAuditScope: Counts from Get-Content/[regex] scoped to DBHealthPage.tsx; not whole-app violations acceptance. Zero matches in limited patterns do not imply zero design/trust issues.
